# docker_images (Data Source)

Lists the images in the provider's daemon image store, like `docker image ls` (`GET /images/json`), sorted by ID. The optional arguments are Engine API filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every tagged nginx image on the daemon (docker image ls).
data "docker_images" "nginx" {
  reference = "nginx"
  dangling  = false
}

output "nginx_image_ids" {
  value = data.docker_images.nginx.ids
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `all` (Boolean) Also list intermediate images (`--all`). Default `false`.
- `before` (String) Only images created before this image (name or ID) (`before` filter).
- `dangling` (Boolean) `true` lists only untagged images, `false` only tagged ones (`dangling` filter).
- `labels` (Map of String) Only images carrying every one of these labels; an empty value matches any value (`label` filter).
- `reference` (String) Only images whose reference matches this pattern, e.g. `nginx` or `ghcr.io/org/*:1.*` (`reference` filter).
- `since` (String) Only images created after this image (name or ID) (`since` filter).
- `until` (String) Only images created before this time: a timestamp or a Go duration such as `24h` (`until` filter).

### Read-Only

- `content_sha256` (String) sha256 of images_json.
- `docker_server_version` (String) Docker Engine version from GET /version.
- `engine_api_version` (String) Engine API version negotiated with the daemon (min of the client maximum and GET /version ApiVersion).
- `ids` (List of String) IDs of the listed images, sorted.
- `images` (Attributes List) The GET /images/json response as a nested object, field by field. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--images))
- `images_json` (String) The Engine API GET /images/json response as JSON; entries sorted by ID. Re-encoded, not byte-exact: the moby client keeps no raw body for this call, so this is the decoded response written as canonical JSON (keys sorted, compact).
